literal: On gengwu day, Huaiyang Administrator Anle rebelled with the south of the city.
idiomatic: On gengwu day, Huaiyang Administrator Anle rebelled with the south of the city.

literal: On xinwei day, the Hephthalites, Persia, Kapisi, Khotantip, Bunazhang, Niuzhangti, and other states [13] each sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: On xinwei day, the Hephthalites, Persia, Kapisi, Khotantip, Bunazhang, Niuzhangti, and other states [13] each sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: On yiyou day, Empress Shun was buried at Yongtai Tomb.
idiomatic: On yiyou day, Empress Shun was buried at Yongtai Tomb.

literal: In the eleventh month, on dingwei day, keeping brood mares in Henan was forbidden.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingwei day, keeping brood mares in Henan was forbidden.

literal: From Jieshi to Sword Pass, seven thousand li east to west, twenty-two commandants were established.
idiomatic: From Jieshi to Sword Pass, seven thousand li east to west, twenty-two commandants were established.

literal: On jiyou day, Avatamsaka, Haribhanga, Dhapabhatara, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: On jiyou day, Avatamsaka, Haribhanga, Dhapabhatara, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: In the twelfth month, on wuwu day, an edict stated: soldiers of Zhongli who fell in battle were to have one household's field tax remitted for three years.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuwu day, an edict stated that soldiers of Zhongli who fell in battle were to have one household's field tax remitted for three years.

literal: On xinyou day, Tenavatamsaka, Sphabhadra, Aselmochebhara, and other states sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: On xinyou day, Tenavatamsaka, Sphabhadra, Aselmochebhara, and other states sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: On jiazi day, the Rouran and Gaoche subject Tamogu led his tribe to submit.
idiomatic: On jiazi day, the Rouran and Gaoche subject Tamogu led his tribe to submit.

literal: On dingchou day, Bolun, Paulvobuddhasena, Gandhara, and other states sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: On dingchou day, Bolun, Paulvobuddhasena, Gandhara, and other states sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: First year of Yongping, spring, first month, on wuxu day, Yingchuan Administrator Wang Shennian fled to Xiao Yan.
idiomatic: In the first year of Yongping, spring, first month, on wuxu day, Yingchuan Administrator Wang Shennian fled to Xiao Yan.

literal: Second month, on xinwei day, Wuji and South Tianzhu each sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: In the second month, on xinwei day, Wuji and South Tianzhu each sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: Third month, on wuzi day, Prince Chang died.
idiomatic: In the third month, on wuzi day, Prince Chang died.

literal: On jihai day, Silla, Ava, Bira, Ayiduo, Vanaka, Gashida, Khotan, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: On jihai day, Silla, Ava, Bira, Ayiduo, Vanaka, Gashida, Khotan, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: On bingwu day, because of last year's drought and famine, envoys were dispatched to every place to give relief.
idiomatic: On bingwu day, because of last year's drought and famine, envoys were dispatched everywhere to give relief.

literal: Summer, fourth month: the state of Avar sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer the state of Avar sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: Fifth month, on guiwei day, the state of Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guiwei day, the state of Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: On xinmao day, because of drought the emperor reduced his meals and withdrew suspended music.
idiomatic: On xinmao day, because of drought the emperor reduced his meals and withdrew suspended music.

literal: Sixth month, on renshen day, an edict stated: "Careful imprisonment and weighty punishments are set forth in ancient instructions.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renshen day, an edict stated, "Careful imprisonment and weighty punishments are set forth in ancient instructions.

literal: We have received this precious succession; clear vision does not yet extend far, and Our deciding doubtful and tangled cases truly gives cause for shame.
idiomatic: We have received this precious succession; clear vision does not yet extend far, and our deciding doubtful and tangled cases truly gives cause for shame.

literal: We may follow the old plans of Luoyang and repair the Hall for Hearing Lawsuits; begin work in the gaps of farming seasons and have it ready by winter.
idiomatic: We may follow the old plans of Luoyang and repair the Hall for Hearing Lawsuits, begin work in the gaps of farming seasons, and have it ready by winter.

literal: We shall personally attend with the kings, dukes, and ministers to examine and question."
idiomatic: We shall personally attend with the kings, dukes, and ministers to examine and question."

literal: On guiyou day, the state of Gaoche sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: On guiyou day, the state of Gaoche sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, on xinmao day, Gaoche, Khitan, Hanban, Kapisa, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinmao day, Gaoche, Khitan, Hanban, Kapisa, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: On jiawu day, Lady Gao was installed as empress.
idiomatic: On jiawu day, Lady Gao was installed as empress.

literal: On yiwei day, an edict stated: "Examine prisons by feeling and try cases by the five hearings; cangues and bastinadoes, large and small, should each have fixed standards.
idiomatic: On yiwei day, an edict stated, "Examine prisons by feeling and try cases by the five hearings; cangues and bastinadoes, large and small, should each have fixed standards.

literal: Yet lately the Court of Justice, Sizhou, Henan, Luoyang, Heyin, and various prison officials—in the reasoning of inquisitions—have not fully shown pity and forgiveness; the suffering of forced confession is often too harsh and cruel, which is not how to revere the statutes, measure the inner heart, and value life in applying punishments.
idiomatic: Yet lately the Court of Justice, Sizhou, Henan, Luoyang, Heyin, and various prison officials—in the reasoning of inquisitions—have not fully shown pity and forgiveness; the suffering of forced confession is often too harsh and cruel, which is not how to revere the statutes, measure the inner heart, and value life in applying punishments.

literal: When injustice is pushed to excess, it truly wounds Our breast.
idiomatic: When injustice is pushed to excess, it truly wounds our breast.

literal: Have the Ministry of State carefully inspect the grounds for cangues and bastinadoes that violate regulations and report conclusions on sentencing."
idiomatic: Have the Ministry of State carefully inspect the grounds for cangues and bastinadoes that violate regulations and report conclusions on sentencing."

literal: Eighth month, on guihai day, Jizhou Inspector and Prince of the Capital Region Yuan Yu held the province in rebellion.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guihai day, Jizhou Inspector Yuan Yu, Prince of the Capital Region, held the province in rebellion.

literal: On yichou day, Acting Minister of State Li Ping was made General Who Pacifies the North and acting commissioner for Jizhou to campaign against him.
idiomatic: On yichou day, Acting Minister of State Li Ping was made general who pacifies the north and acting commissioner for Jizhou to campaign against him.

literal: On dingmao day, a great amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
idiomatic: On dingmao day, a great amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

literal: On gengwu day, Tuyuhun and Kumo Xi each sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: On gengwu day, Tuyuhun and Kumo Xi each sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: Ninth month, on xinsi day, the new moon, Li Ping greatly defeated Yuan Yu at Caoxiao.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinsi day, the new moon, Li Ping greatly defeated Yuan Yu at Caoxiao.

literal: On bingxu day, the former Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying's original enfeoffment was restored.
idiomatic: On bingxu day, the former Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying's original enfeoffment was restored.

literal: On renchen day, the state of Rouran sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: On renchen day, the state of Rouran sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: Dingzhou Inspector and Prince of Anle Yuan Quan greatly defeated Yuan Yu north of Xindu.
idiomatic: Dingzhou Inspector Yuan Quan, Prince of Anle, greatly defeated Yuan Yu north of Xindu.

literal: On wuxu day, Palace Attendant and Grand Preceptor Yuan Xie, Prince of Pengcheng, was executed.
idiomatic: On wuxu day, Palace Attendant and Grand Preceptor Yuan Xie, Prince of Pengcheng, was executed.

literal: On xinchou day, an edict pardoned the people of Jizhou among corvée laborers who had been misled by Yuan Yu; those who could behead and capture rebels were to receive special rewards.
idiomatic: On xinchou day, an edict pardoned the people of Jizhou among corvée laborers who had been misled by Yuan Yu; those who could behead and capture rebels were to receive special rewards.

literal: On guimao day, Li Ping took Xindu; Yuan Yu fled north. Those Yuan Yu had appointed—Jizhou Governor Wei Chao, Right Guard General Mu Ya, [14] Vice Minister of State Liu Zizhi, and Minister of Personnel Cui Fei—were beheaded.
idiomatic: On guimao day, Li Ping took Xindu and Yuan Yu fled north. Li Ping beheaded those Yuan Yu had appointed—Jizhou Governor Wei Chao, Right Guard General Mu Ya, [14] Vice Minister of State Liu Zizhi, and Minister of Personnel Cui Fei.

literal: Commander-in-Chief Sun Tou captured Yuan Yu and sent him to Xindu.
idiomatic: Commander-in-Chief Sun Tou captured Yuan Yu and sent him to Xindu.

literal: The assembled ministers asked that Yuan Yu be executed; the emperor did not consent and ordered him sent to the capital.
idiomatic: The assembled ministers asked that Yuan Yu be executed; the emperor did not consent and ordered him sent to the capital.

literal: Jizhou was pacified.
idiomatic: Jizhou was pacified.

literal: On gengzi day, Yingzhou Chief Clerk Peng Zhen, Administrator-in-Chief Du Rongzu, and others plotted rebellion and secretly brought Xiao Yan's troops into Yiyang; Yingzhou Inspector Lou Yue attacked and drove them off.
idiomatic: On gengzi day, Yingzhou Chief Clerk Peng Zhen, Administrator-in-Chief Du Rongzu, and others plotted rebellion and secretly brought Xiao Yan's troops into Yiyang; Yingzhou Inspector Lou Yue attacked and drove them off.

literal: An edict ordered Generals Hu Jizhi, Qu Zu, and others south to Yiyang.
idiomatic: An edict ordered Generals Hu Jizhi, Qu Zu, and others south to Yiyang.

literal: Garrison commanders of the Three Passes Hou Deng, Yang Fengsheng, and others rebelled with the south of the city; Lou Yue ringed the city and held firm.
idiomatic: Garrison commanders of the Three Passes Hou Deng, Yang Fengsheng, and others rebelled with the south of the city; Lou Yue ringed the city and held firm.

literal: Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying was sent to command thirty thousand foot and horse to go to their relief.
idiomatic: Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying was sent to command thirty thousand foot and horse to go to their relief.

literal: Tenth month of winter, on dingsi day, an edict restored the former Prince of Beihai Yuan Xiang's original enfeoffment and buried him with princely rites.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingsi day, an edict restored the former Prince of Beihai Yuan Xiang's original enfeoffment and buried him with princely rites.

literal: Bai Zaosheng of Pengcheng in Yuzhou killed Inspector Sima Yue [15] and rebelled with the south of the city; Xiao Yan sent the generals Qi Gouren and three others to assist him.
idiomatic: Bai Zaosheng of Pengcheng in Yuzhou killed Inspector Sima Yue [15] and rebelled with the south of the city; Xiao Yan sent Generals Qi Gouren and three others to assist him.

literal: An edict named Minister of State Xing Luan acting commissioner for Yuzhou and ordered General Cui Xuan to lead cavalry to campaign against them.
idiomatic: An edict named Minister of State Xing Luan acting commissioner for Yuzhou and ordered General Cui Xuan to lead cavalry to campaign against them.

literal: On bingzi day, Xing Luan greatly defeated the armies of Bai Zaosheng and Gouren at Baokou.
idiomatic: On bingzi day, Xing Luan greatly defeated the armies of Bai Zaosheng and Gouren at Baokou.

literal: On dingchou day, previously the Suyu garrison commander Cheng Anle's son Jing Jun had killed Suyu Garrison Commander Yan Zhongxian and rebelled with the south of the city.
idiomatic: On dingchou day, previously the Suyu garrison commander Cheng Anle's son Jing Jun had killed Suyu Garrison Commander Yan Zhongxian and rebelled with the south of the city.

literal: Eleventh month, on gengyin day, an edict ordered General Who Pacifies the East Yang Chun to lead forty thousand men to attack Suyu.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengyin day, an edict ordered General Who Pacifies the East Yang Chun to lead forty thousand men to attack Suyu.

literal: Twelfth month, on jiwei day, Xing Luan took Xuanhu, beheaded Bai Zaosheng, captured Qi Gouren and others, and took more than three thousand of Xiao Yan's soldiers captive; they were distributed among kings, dukes, and those below.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiwei day, Xing Luan took Xuanhu, beheaded Bai Zaosheng, captured Qi Gouren and others, and took more than three thousand of Xiao Yan's soldiers captive; they were distributed among kings, dukes, and those below.

literal: On guihai day, Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying defeated Yan's generals at Chucheng and captured Yan's General Who Calms the North Zhang Yi and others.
idiomatic: On guihai day, Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying defeated Xiao Yan's generals at Chucheng and captured his General Who Calms the North Zhang Yi and others.

literal: [16] Yingzhou Inspector Lou Yue defeated Yan's general Ma Xianbi at Jinshan.
idiomatic: [16] Yingzhou Inspector Lou Yue defeated Xiao Yan's general Ma Xianbi at Jinshan.

literal: On renshen day, seventeen thousand households of Han River eastern Man submitted inward in succession.
idiomatic: On renshen day, seventeen thousand households of Han River eastern Man submitted inward in succession.

literal: On bingzi day, the state of Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: On bingzi day, the state of Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: That year, King Qu Jia of Gaochang sent his elder brother's son, the self-appointed Left Guard General Xiaoliang, with a memorial to court, asking to move inward and begging troops to receive them.
idiomatic: That year, King Qu Jia of Gaochang sent his elder brother's son, the self-appointed Left Guard General Xiaoliang, with a memorial to court, asking to move inward and begging troops to receive them.

literal: Second year, spring, first month: Xiao Yan sent Wang Shennian to raid Southern Yan.
idiomatic: In the second year, spring, first month, Xiao Yan sent Wang Shennian to raid Southern Yan.

literal: An edict named Assistant General Changsun Zhi acting General Who Pacifies the South as commander-in-chief and ordered Commanders-in-Chief Bing Qiu and five armies to campaign against him.
idiomatic: An edict named Assistant General Changsun Zhi acting general who pacifies the south as commander-in-chief and ordered Commanders-in-Chief Bing Qiu and five armies to campaign against him.

literal: On dinghai day, Humu, Buduomo, Niumi, Panshi, Simowanjin, Xindouna, Yuebaniu, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: On dinghai day, Humu, Buduomo, Niumi, Panshi, Simowanjin, Xindouna, Yuebaniu, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: On renchen day, the Hephthalites and Bozhi sent envoys to court and presented one white elephant.
idiomatic: On renchen day, the Hephthalites and Bozhi sent envoys to court and presented one white elephant.

literal: On yiwei day, the state of Gaochang sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: On yiwei day, the state of Gaochang sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: On bingshen day, Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying pressed Xiao Yan's Changbo garrison; on wuxu day it broke at night; killed and wounded numbered in the thousands.
idiomatic: On bingshen day, Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying pressed Xiao Yan's Changbo garrison; on wuxu day it broke at night; killed and wounded numbered in the thousands.

literal: On dingyou day, Wuyang Pass was taken; Yan's Cloud Cavalry General and Baron of Songzi County Ma Guang, Champion General and Viscount of Qianling County Peng Fusheng, Valiant Cavalry General and Baron of Dangyang County Xu Yuanji, and twenty-six other generals were captured; captives exceeded seven thousand.
idiomatic: On dingyou day, Wuyang Pass was taken; Xiao Yan's cloud cavalry general and baron of Songzi County Ma Guang, champion general and viscount of Qianling County Peng Fusheng, valiant cavalry general and baron of Dangyang County Xu Yuanji, and twenty-six other generals were captured; captives exceeded seven thousand.

literal: They pressed the attack on Huangxian and Xiguan.
idiomatic: They pressed the attack on Huangxian and Xiguan.

literal: Yan's general Ma Xianbi abandoned Xiguan; Li Yuanlu abandoned Huangxian and fled.
idiomatic: Xiao Yan's general Ma Xianbi abandoned Xiguan; Li Yuanlu abandoned Huangxian and fled.

literal: That month, the monk Liu Huiwang of Jingzhou gathered a crowd and rebelled.
idiomatic: That month, the monk Liu Huiwang of Jingzhou gathered a crowd and rebelled.

literal: An edict ordered Huazhou Inspector Xi Kangsheng to campaign against him.
idiomatic: An edict ordered Huazhou Inspector Xi Kangsheng to campaign against him.

literal: Second month, on yimao day, an edict stated: "Lately military campaigns have arisen in succession; many weapons are ruined and broken, and the armaments in store are now few indeed.
idiomatic: In the second month, on yimao day, an edict stated, "Lately military campaigns have arisen in succession; many weapons are ruined and broken, and the armaments in store are now few indeed.

literal: In security do not forget danger—so the ancients warned; the five weapons must be fully stocked, and once manufacture is undertaken it is heavy work that none but the multitude can undertake.
idiomatic: In security do not forget danger—so the ancients warned; the five weapons must be fully stocked, and once manufacture is undertaken it is heavy work that none but the multitude can undertake.

literal: Now measure and manufacture forty thousand men's mixed arms."
idiomatic: Now measure and manufacture forty thousand men's mixed arms."

literal: Third month, on guiwei day, Madura, Ayasosutuojian, and Divoluo and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: In the third month, on guiwei day, Madura, Ayasosutuojian, and Divoluo and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiyou day, an edict ordered that because Wuchuan Garrison was in famine, granaries were to be opened for relief.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiyou day, an edict ordered that because Wuchuan Garrison was in famine, granaries were to be opened for relief.

literal: On jiazi day, an edict stated: "The sage succors the age, following things in decline or ascent; sometimes upright, sometimes expedient—there is no constant that always holds.
idiomatic: On jiazi day, an edict stated, "The sage succors the age, following things in decline or ascent; sometimes upright, sometimes expedient—there is no constant that always holds.

literal: The former court, when the cloud carriage had just moved and the Song foundation was first raised, moved the people of the Yellow and Luo but the old had not yet been settled; the new dwellings of Dai had still not been completed.
idiomatic: The former court, when the cloud carriage had just moved and the Song foundation was first raised, moved the people of the Yellow and Luo but the old had not yet been settled; the new dwellings of Dai had still not been completed.

literal: Southwest of Yique, the southern barbarians were packed in crowds;
idiomatic: Southwest of Yique, the southern barbarians were packed in crowds;

literal: at Mianyang the rebel cities linked towns into garrisons;
idiomatic: at Mianyang the rebel cities linked towns into garrisons;

literal: those foolish Ba, stupid in heart, had not yet given pure allegiance.
idiomatic: those foolish Ba, stupid in heart, had not yet given pure allegiance.

literal: Therefore for a time We suppressed the benevolence that nurtures life and temporarily relaxed the laws that purge wickedness.
idiomatic: Therefore for a time we suppressed the benevolence that nurtures life and temporarily relaxed the laws that purge wickedness.

literal: Now the capital is heaven-fortified and unlike the past.
idiomatic: Now the capital is heaven-fortified and unlike the past.

literal: Yang, Ying, Jing, and Yi are all fully Ours;
idiomatic: Yang, Ying, Jing, and Yi are all fully ours;

literal: the various barbarians who hold defiles—none fail to submit;
idiomatic: the various barbarians who hold defiles—none fail to submit;

literal: the hearts of the people of Shang and Luo are truly twice what they were in former days.
idiomatic: the hearts of the people of Shang and Luo are truly twice what they were in former days.

literal: Only south of Fan and Xiang has benevolence departed from the Way and government gone awry; held back from transformation, it is not the people's fault.
idiomatic: Only south of Fan and Xiang has benevolence departed from the Way and government gone awry; held back from transformation, it is not the people's fault.

literal: Yet worthless fellows lightly raid and plunder, slaughter the good, and tear fathers from sons and brothers apart.
idiomatic: Yet worthless fellows lightly raid and plunder, slaughter the good, and tear fathers from sons and brothers apart.

literal: The cruelty of Yan is indeed deep.
idiomatic: The cruelty of Xiao Yan is indeed deep.

literal: Now release the people he has plundered and show them great favor; set aside these remnant bandits and their unfulfilled guilt.
idiomatic: Now release the people he has plundered and show them great favor; set aside these remnant bandits and their unfulfilled guilt.

literal: Also order the frontier provinces and garrisons: from now on they are not to hear of raiding and robbery beyond the border; offenders are guilty as if within the realm.
idiomatic: Also order the frontier provinces and garrisons: from now on they are not to hear of raiding and robbery beyond the border; offenders are guilty as if within the realm.

literal: If provincial or garrison commanders and chief generals know and tolerate without impeachment, they are to be punished according to law."
idiomatic: If provincial or garrison commanders and chief generals know and tolerate without impeachment, they are to be punished according to law."

literal: Fifth month: the state of Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: In the fifth month the state of Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: On xinchou day, because of drought the emperor reduced his meals, withdrew suspended music, and forbade slaughter.
idiomatic: On xinchou day, because of drought the emperor reduced his meals, withdrew suspended music, and forbade slaughter.

literal: On jiachen day, he visited the Hualin Capital Pavilion and personally examined prisoners; those guilty of capital crimes and below were reduced one degree.
idiomatic: On jiachen day, he visited the Hualin Capital Pavilion and personally examined prisoners; those guilty of capital crimes and below were reduced one degree.

literal: Sixth month: the state of Gaochang sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: In the sixth month the state of Gaochang sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: On xinhai day, an edict stated: "Within the four seas the rivers and sea are one; carts and writing should be unified, yet the wheel tracks of the provinces north and south are not equal.
idiomatic: On xinhai day, an edict stated, "Within the four seas the rivers and sea are one; carts and writing should be unified, yet the wheel tracks of the provinces north and south are not equal.

literal: Now proclaim and order the four quarters so that far and near are not two."
idiomatic: Now proclaim and order the four quarters so that far and near are not two."

literal: Seventh month of autumn, on guiwei day, the state of Khitan sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guiwei day, the state of Khitan sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: Eighth month, on dingwei day, the state of Dengzhi sent envoys presenting tribute.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingwei day, the state of Dengzhi sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: On wushen day, Xianglanqi, heir of the state of Dengzhi, was installed as its king.
idiomatic: On wushen day, Xianglanqi, heir of the state of Dengzhi, was installed as its king.
